description: List SPRINTS in SimplifyQA — id, name, parent release, state, planned dates. Pass `releaseId` (from list_releases) to see sprints of one release; omit to see every sprint the token can see. To answer "how many stories in this sprint", follow up with story_list({ sprintId }). Requires a live connection. Read-only.

releaseId.description: Only sprints belonging to this release (from list_releases).

name: list_sprints
title: List sprints (optionally within a release)
